scientific_task: Three-dimensional chip-temperature finite-difference update with power forcing and ambient heat exchange
mathematical_operation: Positive-weight seven-neighbor thermal RC update, clamped spatial edge neighbors, source ambient parameter80 and power source.
description: The source constants identify chip geometry, silicon heat capacity/conductivity, power and ambient temperature. The kernel maps one x/y cell per thread and sweeps z using three rolling register temperatures.
community_use_case: Thermal-update building block; no complete chip-model calibration or physical-temperature accuracy certificate.
accuracy_requirements: Declared actual Float32 coefficients/inputs and full time-level arrays against an independent Float64 stencil. Public even-step output defect is retained and excluded from scientific recommendations.
